projection.basis: The brown architectural plan on the visitor leaflet was visually inspected as top-down geometry, including the courtyard and irregular partitions. Brown text masks do not alter the retained wall projection.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: Physical page 2, English visitor plan, visually compared with isolated image 27. Orthographic map. Brown structural ink retains wall thickness, doorway breaks and courtyard colonnade. Brown collection-description text is explicitly masked within its printed text bounds; stair treads and diagonally hatched non-gallery areas remain flat. All 35 printed room identifiers are transcribed at their original label positions, including 1A. Numbers 16,17,25,26 are not printed and are not invented. June 2024 education attribution appears on the sheet despite the 2023 filename.
